newsitem.title: DUBAI: Islamic countries plan $250 mln shipping firm.
newsitem.headline: Islamic countries plan $250 mln shipping firm.

text.p: The Organisation of the Islamic Conference (OIC) is putting its weight behind shipowners in 50 member states seeking to form a Islamic shipping company, the London-based Asharq al-Awsat newspaper said on Wednesday.
Federation of Islamic Shipowners (FIS) secretary general Abdulatif Sultan was quoted as saying the proposed company was likely to be based in Jeddah and have capital of $250 million.
The FIS is affiliated to the OIC -- the Moslem world's main organisation with 52 members.
Initially, the company would operate between Dakar in Senegal and Dhaka in Bangladesh via member states' ports.
"The company will offer its share to individuals and shipping companies in the member states," Sultan added.
Speaking at a FIS general assembly in Jeddah, he said shipping companies in member states currently handled only about seven percent of the cargo traffic to and from their ports.
